title: A free answer differs from reassurance

captions.physics: Hinting at uncertainty instead of asking
captions.emotions: Feeling attached to a wanted reassurance

meaning: You can hint at your uncertainty and hear each person’s actual readiness, noticing attachment to reassurance wanted in place of a definite answer.
text: The Moon in the physical position of your Vishuddha can appear in a hint about uncertainty instead of a direct question. The Lovers in energy support a wish to hear each person’s actual readiness and preserve free choice about participation. The Devil in emotions brings attachment to a wanted reassurance. You can seek a living exchange while feeling that only particular words will restore calm. That wish does not prescribe an obligatory answer for both.

For example, before a story continues comes “Perhaps I had better say nothing”. It may remain unclear whether present willingness to listen or complete permission to discuss everything is wanted. **Actual participation is not unlimited reassurance**. You can ask directly about the current exchange. Yet “You can always tell me everything” may feel especially desirable. Wanting this phrase can be acknowledged as an experience without making a limited honest reply a rejection of all participation. The immediate question and the larger wish do not have to receive identical answers.

Difficulty grows if no particular willingness counts as sufficient without a promise covering every future conversation. Free choice supposedly lasts only until a first limit. Constructive Lovers energy helps preserve mutuality in a present answer. You can hear readiness for today’s subject and acknowledge wanting more; attachment to particular words has room without becoming a condition requiring the other person to surrender the right to a different response.
